narrative.title: The Warehouse Pallet Bay
narrative.scenario: A fulfillment center loads pallets into a single loading bay where only the most recently placed pallet is reachable. Workers can drop a new pallet onto the bay or haul the top pallet away; anything buried underneath is untouchable until everything above it leaves. You are asked to run this bay: accept drop-off commands and retrieval commands, and report what each retrieval yields.
narrative.inputFormat: A list of operations, each either ["push", value] to load a pallet or ["pop"] to remove the top pallet.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the list of values produced by every pop operation, in order; a pop on an empty bay yields -1.
constraints: The structure behaves as LIFO: the last pushed element is the first popped

testCases.explanation: Push 2 then 3; pop returns the last pushed value 3. Push 4; pop returns 4.
The first pop yields 7; the second finds an empty stack and returns -1.
